meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能接入 Microsoft Teams,在团队频道、群聊和私聊里收发消息;同时会引导你完成 Teams 应用的注册、安装和接线等设置。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Teams 频道集成或把机器人接入 Teams 时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Microsoft Teams 集成。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并引导你完成 Teams 设置。

say.text: 把机器人接入 Teams 频道。
say.note: 会检查凭据并执行创建、安装等步骤。

say.text: 设置 Teams 机器人用于群聊。
say.note: 需要你提供公网 URL 和应用名等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can exchange messages in Teams team channels, group chats, and direct messages. The skill also walks you through registering, installing, and wiring the Teams app.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add Microsoft Teams channel integration or connect the bot to Teams.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams integration for me.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and guides you through setup.

say_en.text: Connect the bot to a Teams channel.
say_en.note: Checks credentials and runs creation/installation steps.

say_en.text: Set up the Teams bot for group chats.
say_en.note: Will ask for your public URL and app name.
